summary: Request: gap analysis and signed temporal anchoring for audit/siem export (per-tenant delivery)
description:
Issue summary:
- Customer asked for a forensics-grade audit export and SIEM ingest sample for a two-week window (2026-02-22 to 2026-03-07) together with per-batch signed manifests and temporal anchoring statements for legal review.

Impact:
- Customer (Finovate Bank Ltd.) reporting missing events in their ingestion; their security team requires cryptographic attestations for every delivered batch to complete an internal audit. Missing items block their SOC audit sign-off.

Environment:
- prod | us-east (tenant: finovate-prod, export route: s3-siem-bridge-us-east)

Steps to reproduce / customer observed behavior:
1) Customer polled S3 bucket for delta manifests between 2026-02-22 and 2026-03-07.
2) They found a gap: resume-token 0000e9f2 appears to have advanced without a corresponding manifest (approx. 2026-02-28 03:12:00 UTC).
3) SIEM ingestion reports HMAC mismatch warnings for one of three rehydrated batches (batch id: b-20260228-0310).

Expected behavior:
- Every exported batch should have a signed manifest (ED25519) and a resume-token mapping. No token should be skipped; HMAC of delivered artifacts should match manifest.

Actual behavior observed:
- One batch shows HMAC mismatch on customer's side. There appears to be a ~12 minute delay on the export job around 2026-02-28 03:00–03:15 UTC and a missing manifest object for the resume-token noted.

Attachments provided by customer:
- s3 object listing (redacted), sample event ids (5 ids), partial SIEM error log snippet (redacted).

Customer ask / acceptance criteria:
- Provide a signed (ED25519) manifest for every batch in window with offsets and resume-tokens.
- Produce a gap analysis explaining why resume-token advanced without manifest.
- Re-deliver (or provide checksums) for any missing/altered batches and provide timeline + root cause that can be included in their SOC evidence binder.
comments: 2026-03-12 - Evan Chen (Support): Thanks for the details, Maya. I'm beginning verification on our side. Can you confirm the exact S3 prefix and the five sample event IDs you included? Also confirming you want manifests signed with our production ED25519 key (key id: redwood-prod-ed25519-v1)?

2026-03-12 - Johan Svensson (Finovate): Confirming prefix: s3://finovate-prod/exports/siem/2026-02. Event ids: ev_9f2c3, ev_bb12a, ev_7c9d1, ev_20baf, ev_33c1e. We need key id as part of the evidence.

2026-03-13 - Evan Chen (Support): Initial checks: export job executed at 03:02, 03:10, 03:24 UTC. We see a gap in manifest creation at 03:12 window. Raised to infra (INT-402). Slack thread: #support-siem (https://slack.redwoodinc/archives/C01234XYZ).

2026-03-14 - SRE (Aisha Gomez): Observed transient Kafka partition leader rebalance in us-east export pipeline at 2026-02-28 03:11 UTC; one commit might have been processed after manifest upload job started. Posting correlation chart: https://grafana.redwoodinc/d/abcd/export-latency?from=2026-02-28T03:00:00Z&to=2026-02-28T03:30:00Z
Action: preparing re-emit for affected resume-token.
investigation_notes: Checked export-run logs for finovate-prod between 2026-02-28T02:55:00Z and 2026-02-28T03:30:00Z; export-worker-47 reported 'manifest write timeout' followed by a successful write for a follow-up batch. The manifest for resume-token 0000e9f2 did not appear in the s3 index due to a race during commit window.

Kafka broker logs show a brief leader election on partition exports-tenant-12 at 03:11:12 UTC (12s leader switch, increased latency). This correlates with the missing manifest.
Reference: INT-402 and github PR for additional logging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4521

Verified HMAC mismatch: customer's reported checksum differs from the rehydrated object in S3 for batch b-20260228-0310; suspect partial upload or double-encryption artifact when object rotated by lifecycle. Will produce binary diff and re-emit.
resolution:
Work in progress / pending customer approval:
- Support and SRE will generate per-batch signed manifests for the entire requested window and will attach our ED25519 signatures (key id included).
- We will re-emit batch b-20260228-0310 and provide presigned download + SHA256 checksum.
- Provide a short RCA: transient Kafka leader rebalance caused a race that allowed a commit to appear after manifest job scanned offsets; manifest job was retried but the original placeholder object was not created. Fix scheduled: retry logic hardened and manifest job now records in durable metadata before upload (PR 4521).

Next steps for customer: please confirm acceptance criteria and whether you require us to generate an RFC3161 timestamped notarization of the manifest bundle (additional SLA/fee). If yes, confirm billing contact and whether HSM attestation is required.

Planned timeline: produce signed-manifest bundle and re-emitted batch checksums by 2026-03-16 assuming customer confirms RFC3161/no-RFC preference.
